title: Internships 2027/28 – Industrial Design / CMF / Transportation Design (Year Placement)
pay: Paid (London Living Wage; rate not listed)
note: Year-long paid placement in London with three tracks (Industrial Design, CMF, Transportation Design); apply by email with CV and portfolio using the subject line given on the page. No visa information is stated.

facts.duties: Work on live transport, aviation and product projects alongside senior designers, with a structured learning programme.
facts.requirements: Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign are essential; the Transportation track also needs Alias or Blender. No year of study or work-rights requirement is stated.
facts.apply: Email jobs@priestmangoode.com with CV and portfolio; each track has its own required subject line and file-naming format, listed on the employer page (the page shows the year in the subject lines inconsistently, so double-check).
